heritage.jaymoskingdoms.darkvision: Sees in the dark as grey shapes, out to 16 blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.breath.settle: You sit and catch your breath...
message.jaymoskingdoms.breath.caught: You catch your breath. Rest left today: %s hearts.
message.jaymoskingdoms.breath.spent: You have no more breath to spare today. A night's sleep will bring it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.breath.slept: A good night's sleep. Your breath is back.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.lend.haggle_0: Go on, give them a fair price.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.lend.haggle_1: He's right, you know. It's worth more.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.lend.haggle_2: We'll not take a coin less.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.lend.haggle_3: A fair deal, and no more than that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.shout_0: Wake up! Someone's in the camp!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.shout_2: Up, all of you! Something's out there!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.take_cover_: Duck low. Lean out to shoot.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.speech.jay: Behind the wall! Poke 'im from there!
